notes: Market service cards persist server-side status across page reloads
DHCP installation start/success/failure events are retained and shown in notifications
Error status exposes the root-worker failure detail as a tooltip
DHCP installation uses policy-rc.d to prevent unsafe dnsmasq autostart during package installation
Incomplete previous Control Center DHCP installation can be safely recovered when no external DHCP configuration is detected
The Install update button is enabled only when Production metadata is newer than the installed version/build
Manual update requests trigger the root updater through a systemd path unit
